objectives.statement: Recognize common ordinal numbers from first to tenth.
Use ordinal numbers for positions in lines, lists, floors, and rankings.
Choose between cardinal numbers for quantity and ordinal numbers for order.

notes: Must teach ordinal forms for ordering and ranking (positions, floors, list items), including irregular første/andre and the regular -ende pattern. Defer full date expressions to time_dates_and_scheduling and cardinal forms to cardinal_numbers.
